description: This file defines the 'FrameHelper' class which provides utilities to initialize and display a JFrame with specific configurations, handling window events and logging through 'FileLog'.

classes.name: FrameHelper
classes.description: A helper class for creating and managing JFrame windows with default size, event handling, and logging.

methods.name: getFrame
methods.description: Returns the JFrame instance managed by this helper.

methods.name: showFrame
methods.description: Displays the frame with a given component, defaulting to maximize on start.

methods.name: showFrame
methods.description: Displays the frame with a given component, with the option to specify whether to maximize on start.

methods.name: initFrame
methods.description: Initializes the frame size, default close operation, window listeners, and adds the component to the frame.

methods.name: onWindowOpened
methods.description: Handles actions when the window is opened; logs the event.

methods.name: onWindowClosed
methods.description: Handles actions when the window is closed; logs the event and closes the log.

methods.name: getDefaultFontSize
methods.description: Returns the default font size used in the frame.
